findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu event `event.message.content` (chat text, untrusted per the code's own threat-model comment) unmarshaled at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319-320, trimmed and persisted as `action.RawText` (feishu_finance_agent.go:334) -> `runFeishuFinanceAgentAction` -> `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand` -> `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommandLLM` where the raw text becomes the user turn of an LLM chat/completions request (service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:286, POSTed at line 349) -> model output decoded into `feishuFinanceAgentCommand` -> `buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan` -> plan stored as pending -> after card confirm `executeFeishuFinanceAgentPlan` calls `model.AddAffPromotionUsers` (feishu_finance_agent.go:686) and `model.GrantAdminCredits` (feishu_finance_agent.go:695)
Note: Prompt-injection path: arbitrary message text (including third-party content an operator may paste, links, quotes, code blocks) is sent verbatim as the user turn to the LLM, and the LLM's structured output (target account, commission rate, window, withdraw flag, up to 1,000,000 gift credits) is what gets written to promotion/commission/withdrawal/credit state. A successful injection can therefore steer financial writes. Existing mitigations (recorded only, they do not break reachability): sender must be whitelisted AND live Root (`authorizeFeishuFinanceAgentOperator`), `feishuFinanceAgentTargetMentioned` requires the LLM's target_account to appear as a case-insensitive substring of the raw text (weak: any substring such as 'user' matches), server-side bounds cap rate at 50 bps*100 and 1M credits, injection-carrier hints (link/@/quote/code/semantic patterns) are appended as warnings, and execution requires a human confirm click on a card that echoes the raw text and before->after values. The `question` field from the LLM is also echoed back to the chat unescaped via `messenger.ReplyText` (plain text message, so limited to content spoofing, not a separate injection engine).
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 (OpenAPIBase) -> setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting() -> StartFeishuFinanceAgentWS -> runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession(cfg) -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain(cfg.OpenAPIBase) at line 101 -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at line 102 -> larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...) and client.Start at lines 105-106, which dial the derived host
Note: The outbound long-connection host is taken from an environment variable with only suffix trimming (no scheme/host allowlist or validation), and the larkws client presents AppID/AppSecret to whatever host it dials; a poisoned or misconfigured FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE therefore exfiltrates the app credentials and lets a controlling party feed forged message/card events into the finance workflow. Mitigating context (does not break the path): the source is deployment env (operator-controlled, documented as a local smoke-test affordance), not end-user input, so practical exploitation requires env/config compromise.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
